 Lynchburg Macaroni KID Nov. 2-8 Week Ahead & Weekend Events
 Here's what's happening next week in the Lynchburg area!
 By Sandy Wallace 
 November 2, 2026 
 Image Credit: Sandy Wallace 
 Welcome to our weekday guide! This article series publishes on Sundays so you can plan ahead for the coming week (Monday through Thursday) as well as top events for next weekend. This is in addition to our weekend event article that comes out in our newsletter on Thursdays and is shared on our website and Facebook page.
 It's a short week for all students. Lynchburg City, Bedford County, and Campbell County students are all out of school on Monday and Tuesday, Nov. 2-3. Amherst County and Appomattox County students are out of school on only Tuesday, Nov. 3.
 Nov. 3 is election day. It's not a federal holiday, but it is a state holiday, so public offices will be closed, including DMV offices. Most schools serve as voting locations, so all are closed.

 ***An issue we've discovered with the new calendar is that sometimes events drop from the calendar due to changes by the organization. Unlike the old calendar, we don't usually get notification of the change. If you pull up an event and the event is blank, it probably means that the event has been canceled or changed. When possible, we're linking to the Facebook event, organization's website, or Facebook post to avoid this issue. Sorry for any inconvenience.***
